success_definition: Employee uses an AI tool unprompted on a real work task without being asked to.

phase_1.name: Pilot — Behavioral baseline and nudge engine test
target_behaviors: Uses AI to draft first version of a weekly report (Operations)
Uses AI to summarize a customer email before responding (Customer Service)
Uses AI to generate a first-pass meeting agenda (All roles)
nudge_types: In-the-moment task nudge: triggered when employee opens a known repetitive task in Teams or Outlook
Peer propagation signal: anonymized 'someone on your team just did X in 3 minutes with AI'
Weekly reflection prompt: one question about what they tried and what happened
constraints: All nudges are opt-out. Employees can dismiss or pause for 7 days.
No individual AI usage data stored without consent form signed.
No manager visibility into individual behavior — team aggregates only.
No leaderboards or public adoption scores.
success_metrics: % of pilot employees who perform a target behavior at least once (goal: 40%)
Self-reported confidence score increase after 30 days (goal: +18 points)
human_touchpoints: Week 1: Manager briefing — how to read team dashboard and have a coaching conversation
Week 2: Optional employee Q&A session (psychological safety first)
Week 4: HR review of aggregated signals — decide what to carry to Phase 2

phase_2.name: Scale — Full APAC and EMEA rollout with peer layer
new_features_activated: Peer propagation layer: anonymized social proof signals in Teams channels
Manager behavior dashboard: team-level adoption signals, no individual scores
Human coach escalation: employees stuck after 3 nudge cycles flagged for HRBP conversation
Multi-language nudge delivery: Mandarin, French, German, Arabic
target_behaviors_added: Uses AI to prepare for a client meeting (Sales, Client Services)
Uses AI to synthesize feedback from multiple sources (HR, Operations)
Uses AI to draft a policy or process document first draft (Finance, Legal)
success_metrics: % behavior change maintained from Phase 1 cohort after 30 days without active nudges (goal: 65%)
Peer propagation conversion rate: % who try a behavior after social proof signal (goal: 28%)
Manager-observed behavior change rate without being prompted (goal: 42%)
Human coach escalation rate — stalled employees routed to HRBP (goal: under 8%)

phase_3.name: Global — Full 10,000 employee deployment and ROI evidence

roi_evidence_package.primary_metric: % of 10,000 employees who perform a target AI behavior unprompted at least once per week
roi_evidence_package.comparison_baseline: 11% at start of programme (from pulse survey Wave 2)
secondary_metrics: Time saved per employee per week using AI (self-reported)
Manager satisfaction with team AI adoption
NPS score for the coaching nudge system itself

what_does_not_get_automated: Individual performance ratings based on AI usage data
Disciplinary actions triggered by nudge non-response
Public ranking of employees or teams by adoption score
Manager conversations about growth and development
HR decisions about promotion or compensation

key_risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Opt-in framing, clear data consent process, no individual scores, HR communication campaign before launch
Manager behavior is itself a target behavior — nudge the managers too, model the change

key_risks_and_mitigations.risk: Low adoption in LATAM and MEA due to lower LMS completion baseline
key_risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Deploy in local language with regional champions, start with simpler target behaviors, increase human touchpoints
All behavioral data is aggregated and anonymized by default. Individual tracking requires explicit opt-in consent only.
